response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance item (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule barring any return or exchange. Although the customer describes a grinding/failing fan, the facts show defective == False, so the defective exception RET-020 does not apply (and it also requires final_sale == False). No goodwill grant or other higher-priority rule applies.
